description: Windows companion for the Launcher Android app with local-network notes and shared-file access
notes: The official Windows companion is published as a self-contained win-x64 single-file executable; it is not an MSI, Inno Setup, NSIS, or 7-Zip installer. Scoop downloads the executable directly without running an installer.

The launcher redirects LOCALAPPDATA to data\Local and DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR to data\dotnet. The server certificate created by the application under %LOCALAPPDATA%\LauncherCompanion is therefore stored in Scoop's persistent data directory.
Keep the Launcher Companion console window open while the phone is connected. Close the window to stop the local companion server.
The downloaded executable is not Authenticode-signed. No LICENSE file or license declaration was found in the upstream repository; the manifest therefore marks the license as Unknown.

The upstream download uses an opaque, per-upload file identifier rather than a version-derived URL. checkver reads the companion version from the upstream project file, but autoupdate is intentionally omitted because a future download URL cannot be derived safely.
